Chapter 1149: Chapter 15 The Land of Treasures (Subscribe)

Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan entered second, as if traversing a long corridor of time and space.

Finally arriving beneath a silent and empty starry sky.

"Is this within the universe?"

Lin Yuan looked around in all directions, his vast perception quickly spreading, "The oppression of rules is intense, with insights at the Eightfold Realm of Space-Time, it’s challenging to traverse the void extensively here."

In the external Chaos Void, a Chaos Great Saint could traverse the void easily, crossing even one percent or one-tenth of a Void Domain.

However, within this Xuanhuang Universe, one could at most traverse millions of light-years, a drastic difference from before.

"No wonder this universe was established by the unparalleled Great Saint."

Lin Yuan gazed in awe, the more he sensed, the more terrifying this universe appeared; even with rules operating autonomously, it could suppress a Chaos Great Saint.

"In terms of size, this postnatal universe, who knows how many times larger it is than those naturally born universes from the Chaos Void."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

With his current strength, he could easily devastate a naturally born universe, causing it to break prematurely, but this Xuanhuang Universe remains out of reach.

Even after enduring ages, the space-time within the universe gradually enters collapse.

It is imaginable that in its peak, even an unparalleled Great Saint would not dare to enter lightly.

However, this Xuanhuang Universe was painstakingly established by an unparalleled Great Saint like His Majesty Xuanhuang, with immense dedication.

And a naturally born universe? They are casually nurtured by the Chaos Void, incomparable directly.

"My current position is here..."

After arrival, Lin Yuan observed the surroundings while also comparing the areas on the beast skin map, finally pinpointing his location.

"Following this direction yields the greatest rewards."

Lin Yuan selected a predetermined route, with the final destination being His Majesty Xuanhuang’s mausoleum, passing through numerous areas along the way, each containing many treasures and wonders.

Other strong figures entering the Xuanhuang Universe, even those Chaos Great Saints, could only subconsciously move towards the universe’s center. As for gains along the way?

It all depends on luck.

But with Lin Yuan’s prior planning, he ensured maximum gains without wasting time.

So even if nothing were found in the mausoleum, the trip wouldn’t be in vain.

"Let’s go."

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared, reappearing tens of millions of light-years away.

Before Lin Yuan could proceed to another traverse—

"Roar!!!"

A terrifying roar echoed, as a massive octopus-shaped being emerged from the depths of space-time, with hundreds of tentacles sweeping towards Lin Yuan.

The regions passed by the tentacles saw rapid annihilation of space-time.

"Is this... a Xuanhuang Beast?"

Lin Yuan was amazed, immediately recognizing the identity of the creature.

During his past ventures in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, such beings were ubiquitous.

In fact, the Xuanhuang Beast is not truly a creature; though immensely powerful, borrowing the powers of the surrounding world, their intelligence is quite low.

The Profound Xuanhuang defines Xuanhuang Beasts merely as vessels nurturing Xuanhuang Crystals.

In the cultivation of Profound Xuanhuang disciples, Xuanhuang Crystals are essential, such as in Lin Yuan’s cultivation of "Xuanhuang Physique," requiring abundant Xuanhuang Crystals.

"The strength of this Xuanhuang Beast is formidable, nearly reaching the Chaos Realm threshold." Lin Yuan assessed the opponent, concluding internally.

The Xuanhuang Beasts in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had a strength cap at the Nine-stage Million-layer Realm, but here, they’re exponentially stronger, nearing the Chaos Realm threshold.

"However, it’s normal; Xuanhuang Beasts can leverage the surrounding world’s power, and this Xuanhuang Universe’s Origin Source is potent, even amidst collapsing space-time, the boost to strength is formidable."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

A dead camel is bigger than a horse, let alone the fact that the Xuanhuang Universe far exceeds a camel in complexity compared to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Crackling sounds echoed.

Lin Yuan, observing the octopus-shaped Xuanhuang Beast attacking wildly towards him, slightly stirred his mind, and the ’World’ divine skill operated silently.

Under the unseen force of the universe, the Xuanhuang Beast, nearing Chaos Realm threshold, instantly turned to dust.

The intelligence of Xuanhuang Beasts is inherently low, and approaching the Chaos Realm threshold pertains to combat prowess, not essentially making them Chaos Venerables.

Had it been a normal Chaos Venerable, upon seeing Lin Yuan, they would have fled without hesitation. Even if escape was hopeless, they wouldn’t charge fearlessly like this Xuanhuang Beast.

This is just the most straightforward distinction. Compared to Chaos Venerables, Xuanhuang Beasts’ attacks are overly simplistic, repeating just a few moves, making them manageable once patterns are identified.

Of course, here ’manageable’ is based on Lin Yuan’s absolute crushing strength.

If it were a regular Chaos Venerable, even a pinnacle Chaos Venerable, encountering such fearless Xuanhuang Beasts initially would be quite troubling.

The octopus-shaped Xuanhuang Beast’s body collapsed, revealing a massive Xuanhuang Crystal measuring several thousand meters.

"This Xuanhuang Crystal?"

Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened, it was his first time seeing such a large Xuanhuang Crystal, surpassing the sum of all Xuanhuang Crystals nurtured by Xuanhuang Beasts in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

"Now the ’Xuanhuang Physique’ at the Chaos Realm level has hope."

Lin Yuan was content, the "Xuanhuang Physique," a body refining method created by His Majesty Xuanhuang, in its cultivation, demands vast resources.

Here, the resources are not specified types; any resource can become essential for "Xuanhuang Physique."
